Path: write metadata — Studio on a smaller screen | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Filed as ②, but routed as a UX defect. Direction: the body's option A

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:17Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in the Studio layout (inspector column) and the flow canvas's resize handling ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why not the decision box:** Studio stays a desktop tool; fitting the canvas and folding the inspector below a width changes no contract. Why p3: a desktop author is not affected.
- **Direction:**
  - the flow canvas fits to view on resize
  - below the width where the inspector overlaps the canvas, it opens as a drawer
  - on a phone, a one-line hint that Studio is built for a desktop screen
- Serial hazard: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is 5,547 lines (`wc -l` on `main`) and several open Studio cards edit it. Claim after the in-flight one lands, or declare the overlap in the claim.
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 3
Session: `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`
Account: `os-support-ai`
Branch: `claude/issue-11795-studio-narrow-screens`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11795`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface (line numbers on `main` `28557855`). Per triage's direction `6043019702`: Studio stays a desktop tool, the flow canvas fits to view on resize, the inspector opens as a drawer below the width where it overlaps the canvas, and a phone shows a one-line hint.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`: the mount-only centering (about `:730`–`:743`) gains a fit when the canvas's own viewport size changes (a window or panel resize). ⛔ No re-fit on a node add, drag or edit, which that comment protects.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, only the layout:
  - the fold decision (`showFoldedTabs`, about `:2888`–`:2906`);
  - the right-hand properties aside and its rail (about `:3756`–`:3769`).
  
  Below the width where the aside would overlap the canvas, the properties open as a drawer. The empty aside no longer reserves its width.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/wideViewport.ts`: only if a second threshold hook is needed.
- The phone hint: new en and zh rows in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, under the existing Studio prefix.
- The tests beside these, and `.changeset/11795-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- the designers' registration door (objectui#11982's surface: `register-builtins*.ts`, the entry, `preview-registry.ts`);
- any other designer or inspector body;
- the pillar contents;
- `packages/components/src/ui/**` (use the shared `Sheet` or `Drawer` primitive as is);
- `packages/i18n/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over these paths: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell Studio: below tablet width the Automations canvas is squeezed beside a fixed properties aside, and after a resize the flow canvas keeps its old viewport and clips the Start/End cards | the platform path: StudioDesignSurface's fold decision and FlowCanvas's mount-only centering | every author who opens Studio on a smaller or resized window`
Thread-read: 6043019702
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **Open objectui PRs, read 2026-10-08T23:20Z:** this seat's objectui#11982 changes one comment in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and one comment in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, in other regions. It lands first under ruling `6070754914`, and this branch merges `main` after it. No other open PR touches these files.
- **In-flight claims, read 2026-10-08T23:20Z:** seat 2's objectui#11865 (native selects) names none of these files.
- **First-load budget:** this PR lands after objectui#11982, whose ruled re-pin leaves a margin in which "a fix that adds first-load bytes within the margin lands without a ruling" (`6070754914`).

Why `Clause-②: no`: Studio layout inside app-shell. `FlowCanvas` and `StudioDesignSurface` are not reached as types from the package entry, and the hint's rows go to app-shell's unexported dictionary, not to a published pack. Any change to the entry's type graph is a stop: the dev reports it before opening the PR, and the seat amends this line.

ACCEPT — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-09T00:46Z. PR objectui#12015, head `28566ca7`.

- **PR shape:**
  - Draft against `main`. The head is a pure merge of `main` `4babf40` (objectui#11982), with tree `fb695dfd` equal to `git merge-tree` of its parents. `git merge-tree` against `main` `5d77c099` is clean.
  - First line `Fixes #11795`. `Clause-②: no` at line start.
  - The commits carry only the model-free trailer pair. Assignee `os-support-ai`.
- **Scope:** 8 files, +768/−31, on the claim (`6070983570`):
  - `previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`;
  - `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`;
  - `wideViewport.ts`;
  - one en and one zh row in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`;
  - three new pin files;
  - a `patch` changeset on `@object-ui/app-shell`.
  
  No governed path.
- **A deviation, accepted:** the claim named the Interfaces fold lines, but the measured overlap is the Automations pillar's own fixed `w-72` aside. The edits stay layout-only in the same file: the Studio header's hint, plus the Automations pillar's row ref, fold, drawer and shared configuration body. The Interfaces regions are untouched.
- **Diff read (the seat's own):**
  - **The canvas:** `FlowCanvas` re-fits when its viewport *width* changes (`ResizeObserver`; centered; zoom capped at 100%). It ignores height changes, a 0 width and the width it already framed, so a node add, drag or edit moves nothing, as the mount comment promises.
  - **The fold:** the Automations pillar measures its own row (`useIsNarrowerThan`, threshold `AUTOMATIONS_CONFIG_FOLD_WIDTH` = 860 = rail 208 + chrome 68 + aside 288 + one flow column 296). Below it, there is no aside, and a selection opens the same configuration in the shared `Sheet`. Closing it clears the selection, as the aside's ✕ does. Wider rows are unchanged.
  - **The hint:** a phone shows one `role="note"` line, `engine.studio.desktopHint`, in en and zh.
- **Triage's direction honoured** (`6043019702`): fit on resize, a drawer below the overlap width, and a one-line phone hint.
- **Measured in Chromium:**
  - At 390 px the canvas was 34 px beside the 288 px aside.
  - Opened at 390 px and widened to 1024 px, the flow stayed clipped 103 px off the left edge.
  - Both are fixed. The control: a toolbar node add at 1440 px leaves the viewport unchanged.
- **Pins and reverse verification** (dev report `6071911352`): 13 new pins.
  - Dropping the observer turns the 3 re-fit pins red; its controls stay green.
  - Dropping the fold threshold turns the 3 narrow-row pins red; its controls stay green.
  - Each restore is proven (blob equals HEAD).
- **Tests:**
  - **Whole `app-shell` suite on `54dc0e51`:** 1,206 files and 11,715 tests passed.
  - **After the merge, a narrowed run:** 278 files and 2,612 tests passed, with the type-check exiting 0.
- **Gates:** CI on `28566ca7`: 43 runs: 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, its shard template, `dependabot`), 0 failure. `Bundle Analysis` is success: 3160.1 KB against the new 3204.6 KB ceiling. The first-load cost sits in the lazily loaded Studio chunk.
- **The dev's open questions:**
  - **PR body, A:** the seat refreshed the stale objectui#11982 note and added the post-merge verification in this pass.
  - **Docs, B:** objectui's AGENTS.md has no rule requiring a doc line per feature change, and no sentence in `packages/app-shell/README.md` or `content/docs/guide/console.md` becomes false.
- **Contract review:** not required (`Clause-②: no`). The built `dist/index.d.ts` names none of the new identifiers.

Findings, recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes and not filed:
- The pillar bar still scrolls sideways at 390 px. That is deliberate (every pillar and Publish stay reachable); a phone header would be its own change.
- The Data pillar's field aside (`w-80`) would take most of a phone-width row. This was read from source and not measured; the same `useIsNarrowerThan` and `Sheet` shape would carry it.
- Interfaces with an injected `aiSlot` (the cloud seam) keeps its fixed aside at every width, by design.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the queue, now. This seat's objectui#11861, in flight on the *New automation* dialog in the same file, merges `main` after this lands.
